business_summary: Duluth Holdings Inc. sells casual wear, workwear, outdoor apparel, and accessories for men and women in the United States. It offers shirts, pants, shorts, underwear, outerwear, footwear, accessories, and hard goods. The company provides its products under the Duluth Trading, AKHG, Alaskan Hardgear, Armachillo, Ballroom, Buck Naked, Bullpen, Cab Commander, Crouch Gusset, Dang Soft, Dry on the Fly, Duluth Trading Co, Duluthflex, Fire Hose, Flexpedition, Longtail T, NoGA, No Polo Shirt, No Yank, Spit & Polish, and Wild Boar names. It markets its products through its stores, website, direct mail, and customer contact centers. The company was formerly known as GEMPLER'S, Inc. Duluth Holdings Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Mount Horeb, Wisconsin.
business_summary_ko: Duluth Holdings Inc.는 미국에서 남성 및 여성을 위한 캐주얼 의류, 작업복, 아웃도어 의류, 액세서리를 판매합니다. 셔츠, 바지, 반바지, 속옷, 겉옷, 신발, 액세서리 및 생활용품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 Duluth Trading, AKHG, Alaskan Hardgear, Armachillo, Ballroom, Buck Naked, Bullpen, Cab Commander, Crouch Gusset, Dang Soft, Dry on the Fly, Duluth Trading Co, Duluthflex, Fire Hose, Flexpedition, Longtail T, NoGA, No Polo Shirt, No Yank, Spit & Polish 및 Wild Boar라는 이름으로 제품을 제공합니다. 매장, 웹사이트, 다이렉트 메일, 고객 연락 센터를 통해 제품을 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 GEMPLER'S, Inc.로 알려져 있었습니다. Duluth Holdings Inc.는 1989년에 설립되었으며 위스콘신주 Mount Horeb에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
